title: 📱 Vivo confirms the global launch of the 'V80 FE'... 7,000 battery and 50MP camera!
body: 📱 Vivo confirms the global launch of the 'V80 FE'... 7,000 battery and 50MP camera!

Vivo has confirmed that its 'Vivo V80 FE' phone will launch soon in selected global markets, as the latest addition to the 'V80' series. The phone appeared on the company's official website in the Philippines and on the Thai telecom authority's website, signaling it will soon reach more countries.

The phone carries a 6.59-inch AMOLED screen with Full-HD+ resolution, a refresh rate of up to 120 Hz, and maximum brightness of up to 3,000 nits, with water and dust resistance rated IP68 and IP69. It runs on MediaTek's 'Dimensity 7400 Turbo' processor built at 4 nanometers, with a top speed of 2.6 GHz, a huge 7,000 mAh battery, and 90W fast charging.

As for cameras, it comes with a 50-megapixel main lens within a triple system, while leaks suggest the Indian version may come in an exclusive red color, alongside another color. The company has not yet announced the exact launch date or the price, nor its availability in India officially.
Simply put: a huge battery, a bright screen, and full water resistance in a mid-range phone — Vivo is betting the battery alone is enough to convince you.
